def digitSum(s):

    ASCII codes.

    Examples:
        digitSum("") => 0
        digitSum("abAB") => 131
        digitSum("abcCd") => 67

        digitSum("woArBld") => 131
        digitSum("aAaaaXa") => 153

problem_data.canonical_solution:
if s == "": return 0
    return sum(ord(char) if char.isupper() else 0 for char in s)
